Thank you for DD2030 group.
Let me exit this Slack group so that I would avoid referencing to any part of discussion within this group when I am writing about activities around the use of digital democratic tools. I don't think the group needs any formal exit message, but
I like to thank the group for its openness and wish successful executions in Japan and in the world.
